Inconsistent Claim Notification Periods (HIGH RISK) **Source Documents:** - **SPA Clause 9.7:** "Any claim by the Buyer for breach of the Warranties must be notified... within **20 days**" (line 79) - **Escrow Agreement Clause 5.2:** "A claim against the Escrow Amount must be notified within **45 days**" (line 53) **Inconsistency Analysis Table:** | Document | Clause | Notification Period | Trigger Event | Legal Consequence | Risk to Buyer | |----------|--------|-------------------|---------------|-------------------|---------------| | SPA | 9.7 | 20 days | Buyer becomes aware (or ought to be aware) of breach | Claim time-barred after 20 days | Loss of warranty claim | | Escrow Agreement | 5.2 | 45 days | Buyer becomes aware of claim | Escrow claim valid for 45 days | Enforcement conflict | **Date Calculation Implications:** | Scenario | Days Available | Critical Date Calculation | Risk | |----------|---------------|---------------------------|------| | Claim discovered Day 0 | SPA: Day 20 deadline
Escrow: Day 45 deadline | 25-day gap between deadlines | HIGH | | Claim discovered Day 21 | SPA: Already barred (-1 day)
Escrow: Day 24 remaining | Claim valid for escrow but barred for SPA | HIGH | | Claim discovered Day 40 | SPA: Barred 20 days ago
